---
title: Builtin components
description: Reference for the 33 builtin components that adapters and plugins use to build pages, grouped by purpose.
contentType: reference
---

DSUI ships 33 builtin components. You compose them on the server when you build a page, so no React, HTML, or CSS crosses the server boundary. The Plugin SDK re-exports most of them. Each page below lists the component's props, with an example.

To build something that these components can't draw, see [custom components](/docs/build/custom-components).

## Layout

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Grid](/docs/build/components/grid) | CSS grid with 1-6 columns |
| [Columns](/docs/build/components/columns) | Multi-column weighted layout |
| [Flex](/docs/build/components/flex) | Flexbox row or column layout |
| [Stack](/docs/build/components/stack) | Vertical stack with gap |
| [SplitPane](/docs/build/components/split-pane) | Sidebar + content + inspector layout |
| [Tabs](/docs/build/components/tabs) | Tabbed interface |

## Containers

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Card](/docs/build/components/card) | Versatile container with title, badge, and link |
| [Section](/docs/build/components/section) | Titled content block |
| [PageHeader](/docs/build/components/page-header) | Page-level header with title, badge, and actions |
| [Resource](/docs/build/components/resource) | Data-binding wrapper |

## Data display

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Table](/docs/build/components/table) | Data table with rows, actions, and filters |
| [List](/docs/build/components/list) | Readable rows for named things such as jobs, assets, runs, and DAGs |
| [Collection](/docs/build/components/collection) | Iterate over a data source |
| [Value](/docs/build/components/value) | Single field from a data source |
| [KeyValue](/docs/build/components/key-value) | Key-value pairs from a resource or inline data |
| [Meter](/docs/build/components/meter) | Horizontal bar chart with segments |
| [Gauge](/docs/build/components/gauge) | Radial gauge that shows one value against a maximum |
| [Chart](/docs/build/components/chart) | Time series drawn as a line or area, bound to a resource or given as points |
| [Badge](/docs/build/components/badge) | Status indicator with label and tone |
| [Icon](/docs/build/components/icon) | Named icon renderer |
| [ResourceTree](/docs/build/components/resource-tree) | Hierarchical tree navigator |

## Input

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Button](/docs/build/components/button) | Clickable action trigger |
| [Form](/docs/build/components/form) | Zod-driven form |
| [Select](/docs/build/components/select) | Dropdown input |
| [TextInput](/docs/build/components/text-input) | Text input field |
| [Link](/docs/build/components/link) | Navigational link |

## Code

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [CodeBlock](/docs/build/components/code-block) | Read-only syntax-highlighted code |
| [CodeEditor](/docs/build/components/code-editor) | Editable code editor (browser only) |
| [QueryEditor](/docs/build/components/query-editor) | Query editor with explorer sidebar |
| [CodeExplorer](/docs/build/components/code-explorer) | Read-only source browser with file search, breadcrumbs, and a Monaco preview |

## Notebooks

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Notebook](/docs/build/components/notebook) | Full notebook with markdown and code blocks |
| [NotebookCatalog](/docs/build/components/notebook-catalog) | Notebook listing view |

## Overlays

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Target](/docs/build/components/target) | Publishes a stable element ID so a plugin overlay can point at its content |
